Side passion

Coffee

Coffee began as my student job and became a craft. Alongside my studies I worked as a barista and shift lead at Albert Heijn in the Netherlands, and as a barista at Starbucks in Amsterdam. Today I work as a freelance barista. The bar taught me to stay calm and friendly when the queue is long.
